passwordReset.subject: Reset your Mycorrhizal CRM password
passwordReset.intro: We received a request to reset your Mycorrhizal CRM password.
passwordReset.instruction: Use this token to complete the reset within 60 minutes:
passwordReset.ignore: If you did not request this reset, you can ignore this email.

passwordChanged.subject: Your Mycorrhizal CRM password was changed
passwordChanged.intro: Your Mycorrhizal CRM password was just changed.
passwordChanged.warning: If you made this change, you can safely ignore this email. If you didn't, your account may be compromised -- reset your password immediately. As a precaution, all signed-in sessions and API tokens have already been revoked.

notifications.testBody: This is a test notification from Mycorrhizal CRM.
